CI finding on Gerrit 3427 patch set 1 (Verified -1, run 44402939360): the bounded mutation gate's clean-test baseline failed in 3 shards (gates, reducer-processors, signing). The repo-root leak guard reported a new `.ticket-sync-<md5>` entry in each.

Root cause: scripts/mutation_gate.py runs shard tests under bwrap with `/` read-only and only the checkout and pytest basetemp writable. With /tmp read-only, `tempfile.gettempdir()` falls through its candidate list to its documented last resort, the current directory, which is the checkout. So sync_marker_path() now put the marker in the repo root. Before this change the literal /tmp write failed and was swallowed, so nothing appeared.

Fix (amended into this change, patch set 2): execute_shard sets TMPDIR to the writable pytest basetemp for both sandboxed children. That gives the sandbox the writable temp dir that every real host provides, and that the ~30 src/rebar modules already using tempfile rely on. Regression test: tests/scripts/test_mutation_gate.py::test_shard_children_get_a_writable_temp_dir fails without the line and passes with it. Portable: TMPDIR is honoured by tempfile on every platform, and the change touches only the Linux/macOS mutation harness.

make verify on the restacked series: 21416 passed, 30 skipped, 2 failed. The 2 failures were test_a_finished_gate_drive_releases_its_event_loop, from a stale worktree venv (anyio 4.14.2 against the >=4.15 floor). After make install (anyio 4.16.0) both pass when rerun alone. The integration tier was not rerun locally because the host was loaded; CI Verified covers it.
